text: 三井住友DS资产管理因担忧法国财政状况，已卖出所持全部法国政府债券，将资金转向德国国债和短期日本政府债券。欧元区政府债券风险溢价周四大幅上升，显示市场对法国财政和政治局势的担忧正开始蔓延至其他市场。与此同时，美国国债和德国国债上涨，法国和意大利国债利差飙升。三井住友DS资产管理全球固定收益团队首席投资组合经理Shinji Kunibe表示：“法国国债此前提供了相对具有吸引力的持有收益，但鉴于近期事态发展，我们已经卖出了全部持仓。我们已将这些资金主要转向德国国债，另有一部分投向短期日本政府债券。”“我们一直特别关注的一点是各国政府在多大程度上致力于遵守财政
text_en: Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management has sold all of its French government bonds on concerns over France's fiscal situation, shifting the funds into German government bonds and short-term Japanese government bonds. Eurozone government bond risk premiums rose sharply on Thursday, indicating that market concerns over France's fiscal and political situation are beginning to spread to other markets. Meanwhile, US Treasuries and German bunds rose, while the spread between French and Italian government bonds surged. Shinji Kunibe, chief portfolio manager of the global fixed income team at Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management, said: "French government bonds previously offered relatively attractive carry, but given recent developments, we have sold our entire position. We have mainly shifted these funds into German government bonds, with some also going into short-term Japanese government bonds."
